objectives: This is the first course in a two-part series aimed at enhancing business-minded learners’ workplace English proficiency. This semester, the class emphasizes vocabulary development, listening comprehension, and effective speaking techniques. To practice these skills, students will work with materials primarily drawn from TED and MyET, focusing on TOEIC-related themes relevant to international communication. By the end of the course, students will be able to apply functional language to everyday workplace scenarios, communicating with greater effectiveness & diplomacy.
